Subject: Physics
Question type: integer answer (no options)

The charges q/2 and 2 q are placed at the centre of face and corner of a cube respectively. Total flux through the cube is (n q)/(2 ε_0) . The value of ' n ' is

result.working:
A charge at the centre of a face is shared equally by two cubes, so 1/2 of its flux passes through this cube: (1/2)(q/2)/ε₀ = q/(4ε₀).
A charge at a corner is shared by 8 cubes, so 1/8 of its flux passes through this cube: (1/8)(2q)/ε₀ = q/(4ε₀).
Total flux = q/(4ε₀) + q/(4ε₀) = q/(2ε₀).
Comparing with nq/(2ε₀) gives n = 1.
